description: A framework to extend the Microsoft .net framework with extra math functionality.
releaseNotes:
# Release notes
## v9.0.0
- Removed deprecated target frameworks: .net Framework (all), .net Core (5.0 and earlier).
- Refactored base NuGet package into a multi-assembly NuGet package to simplify trimming support.
## v8.3.6
- Adjusted code to work with limitations of Microsoft Dependency Injection.
- Adjusted behaviors of UOM operators when one or both members are empty.
## v8.3.5
- Initial Release
